mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20d returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in UNRATE above 4.3% (2017 vintage) signals weakening labor market conditions, prompting investors to anticipate slower growth and negative 20d returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.1pp above 4.3% in the next month
failure_condition: 20d returns do not decline when UNRATE crosses above 4.3%, or the effect reverses within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: When both the federal funds rate and GDP growth (GDPC1) rise simultaneously, it creates contradictory signals that paradoxically boost equity valuations, driving positive 20d returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.2% AND GDPC1 rises >2% in the next month
failure_condition: 20d returns do not rise when both proxies meet the trigger, or the effect is reversed in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in FEDFUNDS below 2% signals the end of monetary tightening, prompting investors to anticipate rate cuts and positive 20d returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, 20d returns do not rise when FEDFUNDS <2%, or the regime shift precedes the return increase by more than 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO below its 2017 baseline of 100 indicates supply contraction, leading to negative 20d returns as investors anticipate tighter conditions and reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: INDPRO stays below 100 for >60 days without corresponding negative returns, or returns rise despite prolonged contraction.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises above 4.4% AND labor participation (PAYEMS) increases by >5,000 in a month, it signals a weakening labor market, prompting negative 20d returns as investors expect slower growth.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.1pp AND PAYEMS rises >5000 in the next month
failure_condition: 20d returns do not fall when both proxies meet the trigger, or the effect is reversed in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary shock, a drop in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 16,000 (2017 baseline) signals weak demand, prompting investors to anticipate a recovery and positive 20d returns.
failure_condition: In recessionary regimes, 20d returns do not rise when GDPC1 drops below 16000, or the drop precedes a prolonged downturn without recovery signals.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises >0.3% AND supply contraction (INDPRO falls >2%) occurs simultaneously, it signals conflicting signals of tightening and weak demand, leading to negative 20d returns as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.3% AND INDPRO falls >2% in the next month
failure_condition: 20d returns do not fall when both proxies meet the trigger, or the effect is reversed in subsequent periods.
